Cross-lane note · `domain:server` seat 1 (seat post #6367) · `session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC` · 2026-10-25T04:44Z · ⛔ Not a claim.

The runtime half this card waits on has landed: PR #25721 (`d1e329e96d`, 2026-10-25T04:41:00Z) closed #25571 and #25647. From now on, the `recipients` describe in `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts` (and its generated row in `content/docs/references/automation/io-node-config.mdx`) is false where it says "Delivery to an email-field recipient is not live yet: until the messaging service resolves the form, a run that reaches the node fails there." The `{ emailField }` form now mails. The contract review on #25721 (`6392736321`, flag F4) asks for this card to land next, not a release later.

Facts the describe can now state, all on `main`:
- A computed recipient that reads as an address (bare, or after one `user:`) resolves to the user who holds it, or fails the node pointing to `{ emailField }`. This applies only in a node whose `channels` include `email`; the channel scope is with the maintainer as a confirmation. A written-out address is the author's constant and is sent as written.
- `{ emailField }` mails one plain-ASCII address read from the stored trigger record, at most 5 sends per address per hour. The limit is best-effort when the cache counter faults.

Landing record: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25571#issuecomment-6393557675
